name: Table
description: Generic virtualized table of rows (e.g. the loan tape). Listens to filters, exports to Excel. Asset-class / use-case agnostic.

channel.description: Widgets on the same channel share the selected deal and the active filters.
channel.title: Communication Channel

contextKey.description: Which channel value selects the universe (deal name today).
contextKey.title: Context Key

schemaKey.description: Logical table scenario resolved by GraphQL. Returns { columns, rows }.
schemaKey.title: Schema Key

listensToKeys.description: Filter keys this table re-queries on. Empty uses the collateral tape filters. The table listens only; it never emits filters.
listensToKeys.title: Filter Keys

exportEnabled.description: Show the Export to Excel button.
exportEnabled.title: Enable Export

exportFileName.description: File name (without extension) for the Excel export.
exportFileName.title: Export File Name

density.description: Row density. Compact is denser than the standard small table.
density.title: Density

rowHover.description: Highlight the row under the cursor.
rowHover.title: Row Hover Highlight

zebra.description: Shade alternating rows for easier scanning.
zebra.title: Alternating Rows

showTitle.description: Show the title row (icon + label + row count).
showTitle.title: Show Title

titleText.description: Overrides the table title. Blank uses the scenario title from GraphQL.
titleText.title: Custom Title Text
